about: F130 criterion 4: the two traced timelines from socialus-plan planning/briefs/concepts-in-the-store-2026-11-11.md, transcribed entry for entry. Each entry keeps the brief's date and words; an entry naming two changes (built, reversed) is two events on one date. Loaded by scripts/knowledge/concepts.ts.

ruling.words: `Bulletin` is refused as a noun: it named a delivery mode, not a thing.

names.note: Its ruling ("Announcement is the word everywhere") was replaced on 2026-10-01 and lives only in git.

ruling.words: Post is the noun for what a Page says to the metro; an announcement is a kind of post.
